nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 午餐时间的熟食中心像一台全速运转的机器。锅铲声、点单声和四面八方的语言挤在一起，只有一张桌子还留着空位。

nodes.speaker: Mei
nodes.text: Before you sit, check the tissue packet. Here, it can mean the seat is reserved.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 桌边放着一包纸巾，一位端着托盘的老人正朝这边走来。

options.text: 把纸巾挪开，先占下座位

nodes.speaker: Uncle Tan
nodes.text: Only this one. The other seats are free. Join me — eating alone is too quiet.

nodes.speaker: Mei
nodes.text: Wait — better ask first. A tiny question can save a very awkward lunch.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你们围着桌子坐下。Uncle Tan 推荐了一碗香气逼人的叻沙，但摊位上的辣度让你有些犹豫。

options.text: 「Could I have it less spicy, please?」

nodes.speaker: 摊主
nodes.text: Can! Less spicy for you. Try it first, then come back braver next time.

nodes.speaker: 摊主
nodes.text: No problem. You can also say, 'Could I have it less spicy?' Polite and very clear.

nodes.speaker: Uncle Tan
nodes.text: This table is Singapore in miniature. Different food, different accents, same question: can I sit here?

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 一场骤雨砸上铁皮屋顶，陌生人把椅子往里挪了挪。空桌很快变成了交换口味、路线和笑话的小岛。

nodes.speaker: Mei
nodes.text: You did it. One useful sentence found you a seat, a meal, and two new friends.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】雨停了，但你已经不急着离开这张热闹的共享餐桌。
